passages.context: The complete concluding section was inspected with the preceding death narrative. Athanasius explicitly tells readers to use the life to teach monastic discipline and, if useful, to show non-Christians Christ's power over beings Greeks regard as gods. This verifies the work's ascetical and apologetic framing, not the independent historicity of narrated marvels, a frequency or outcome measure, an institutional rite, a diagnostic system, or operational procedure.
